statement_summary: Information security program documented in policies, standards, and the SSP
Security Manager designated Information Security Officer in writing
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment and targeted risk analyses
Risk acceptance authority by level; no crowd-safety risk accepted above Low
PCI DSS scope and data flows documented per channel, confirmed yearly and before changes; evidence before any AOC
Annual review of policies and standards; acknowledgment at hire and yearly
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Service provider list, agreements with security and breach terms, AOCs, responsibility matrix, annual review
Purchasing gate for software, SaaS, AI features, and scripts
Sanctions for policy violations
Total price in every price display; accurate fee names; privacy notice matches practice
Change control for checkout, pricing, bot, tag manager, website, payment device, and firewall changes
Payment page script inventory, authorization, integrity, two-person publishing, weekly tamper detection
AI tools and features approved through the P10 process
Annual independent control assessment
Unique accounts; no shared accounts except sealed, logged break-glass accounts
Role-based least privilege with approval; no more than 6 ticketing administrators
SSO and MFA for every account, including agency and vendor accounts and tag manager publishers
Same-day termination; local and agency accounts and badges within 24 hours; agency end dates
Transfers remove prior access within 5 business days
Quarterly access reviews, including administrator, publishing, and export rights
Separate privileged accounts, just-in-time elevation, security keys for administrators
Lockout after 10 attempts; screen lock and session timeouts
Password length, scoped and vaulted API keys rotated yearly, no default credentials
Third-party remote access through the broker with MFA, approval, and recording
Inactive accounts disabled (45 days SSO; 90 days local)
Incident response plan and runbooks for card compromise and event-day outage
Immediate reporting of suspected incidents, within 1 hour at most
Incident log with time of suspicion and time of determination
Severity 1 activates the crisis management team within 1 hour
Acquirer within 24 hours of suspicion; Visa within 3 days through the acquirer; evidence preserved; PFI if required
Breach determination and notices per the P08 matrix, confirmed by counsel; 5-year decision records
Insurer hotline before incident vendors
Ransom decision requires CEO, counsel, insurer, OFAC check, and law enforcement report
Event-day decisions by the venue General Manager and Director of Safety and Security; life safety first
Unexpected card data treated as an incident and purged
Annual exercise per runbook; responder training
Alerts triaged per STD-02; MSSP escalation within 30 minutes
Lessons learned within 30 days into P01 and P07
Four data classes (Restricted, Confidential, Internal, Public)
No card data storage; card entry only on P2PE devices or provider forms; no card data by email or on paper
Patron data minimization; exports to approved storage, expiring in 30 days
Encryption in transit and at rest
Retention schedule and secure disposal, including at providers
Review and privacy notice update before new uses of patron data
Quarterly card data discovery scans
Confidential data shared only under agreement
Retention for CCTV, bot mitigation records, and crowd analytics outputs
Business use of company systems
Never record card numbers or security codes; payments only on P2PE devices or provider forms
Protect credentials; report unexpected MFA prompts
Report suspected incidents, unknown scripts, wrong prices, and tampered devices
No unapproved software, extensions, or page scripts
Screen lock, encryption, no disabling security tools
Patron data used only for the job; no personal exports
Approved AI tools only; no Restricted data in AI tools; human review of patron-facing AI content
P2PE device inspection before each event by leads
Total price in every price someone posts or sends
Awareness training at hire and yearly, plus role-based modules
